entries.name: value
entries.description: Controlled active tab value.

entries.name: defaultValue
entries.description: Initial active tab value when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first tab.

entries.name: onValueChange
entries.description: Fired when the active tab changes.

entries.name: layoutId
entries.description: Shared-layout id for the active indicator.

entries.name: open
entries.description: Controlled visibility.

entries.name: defaultOpen
entries.description: Initial visibility when uncontrolled.

entries.name: onOpenChange
entries.description: Called after the toggle button or shortcut requests a visibility change.

entries.name: shortcutKey
entries.description: Single-key shortcut used to toggle the sidebar. Pass false to disable it.

entries.name: toggleLabel
entries.description: Accessible label and tooltip text for the toggle button.

entries.name: panelClassName
entries.description: Classes applied to the bordered sidebar panel.

entries.name: text
entries.description: The text to copy, or a function that returns the text.

entries.name: onCopySuccess
entries.description: Called with the copied text on successful copy.

entries.name: onCopyError
entries.description: Called with the error if the copy operation fails.

entries.name: idleIcon
entries.description: Custom icon for idle state.

entries.name: doneIcon
entries.description: Custom icon for done state.

entries.name: errorIcon
entries.description: Custom icon for error state.

entries.name: email
entries.description: Full email address shown in the card.

entries.name: highlights
entries.description: Dock icons and highlight rules. Defaults to username / domain / full.

entries.name: children
entries.description: Label shown while idle and under the fill.

entries.name: icon
entries.description: Icon shown before the label.

entries.name: confirmedLabel
entries.description: Label shown after the hold completes.

entries.name: confirmedIcon
entries.description: Icon shown after the hold completes. Defaults to an animated checkmark.

entries.name: instructions
entries.description: Description announced to assistive technology.

entries.name: fillClassName
entries.description: Class name for the fill layer, e.g. to change its color.

entries.name: alt
entries.description: Accessible description for the character. Use an empty string when decorative.

entries.name: columns
entries.description: Number of equally sized columns in the sprite sheet.

entries.name: deadZone
entries.description: Distance from the character's center that keeps the resting frame active.

entries.name: frames
entries.description: Maps pointer directions to cells in the sprite sheet.

entries.name: idleDelay
entries.description: Time without pointer movement before returning to the center frame.

entries.name: rows
entries.description: Number of equally sized rows in the sprite sheet.

entries.name: src
entries.description: Public URL for the sprite sheet.

entries.name: value
entries.description: Controlled value.

entries.name: defaultValue
entries.description: Initial value when uncontrolled.

entries.name: onValueChange
entries.description: Called on every step, typed commit, and key press.

entries.name: onValueCommit
entries.description: Called when a press is released, a typed value commits, or a key steps.

entries.name: largeStep
entries.description: Steps moved by `Shift`+arrows, `PageUp`/`PageDown`, and accelerated holds.

entries.name: accelerate
entries.description: After 10 repeats, a held button moves `largeStep` steps at a time.

entries.name: format
entries.description: `Intl.NumberFormat` options for the value, e.g. currency or percent.

entries.name: locale
entries.description: Locale for formatting and parsing typed or pasted values.

entries.name: wheel
entries.description: Let the wheel change the value while the input is focused.

entries.name: orientation
entries.description: `vertical` puts increase above the value and decrease below it.

entries.name: sound
entries.description: Play a click per step and a pop at the limits.

entries.name: haptics
entries.description: Trigger haptics on supported devices.

entries.name: name
entries.description: Submits the value with a native form through a hidden input.

entries.name: label
entries.description: Accessible name for the input; the buttons read "Increase {label}".

entries.name: coverClassName
entries.description: Classes applied to the hinged, visible face of the button.

entries.name: peekDelay
entries.description: Delay before each peek, or a random range in milliseconds.
entries.type: number | readonly [min: number, max: number] | undefined

entries.name: peekDuration
entries.description: How long the eyes remain visible in milliseconds.

entries.name: autoPeek
entries.description: Disable the automatic peeking behavior while keeping a usable button.

entries.name: animated
entries.description: Whether the hand-drawn mark animates when it enters the viewport.

entries.name: variant
entries.description: The shape of the hand-drawn mark.

entries.name: scribbleClassName
entries.description: Classes applied only to the hand-drawn mark.

entries.name: open
entries.description: Controlled dialog state.

entries.name: defaultOpen
entries.description: Initial dialog state when uncontrolled.

entries.name: enabledHotkeys
entries.description: Enables the configured modifier shortcut and slash.

entries.name: shortcutKey
entries.description: Character used with Command or Control to open the menu.

entries.name: shortcutModifier
entries.description: Overrides the modifier displayed in the trigger.

entries.name: container
entries.description:
Element to render into instead of `document.body`, such as a phone frame.
Give it `position: relative` and `overflow: clip`.

entries.name: variant
entries.description: `attached` spans the width with rounded top corners; `floating` is inset and fully rounded.

entries.name: open
entries.description: Controlled open state.

entries.name: defaultOpen
entries.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

entries.name: snapPoints
entries.description:
Heights the sheet rests at, lowest first. Numbers are fractions of the
viewport height and px strings are fixed heights. `1` is as tall as the
sheet gets: the viewport less a 24 px gap.

entries.name: activeSnap
entries.description: Controlled index into `snapPoints`.

entries.name: defaultSnap
entries.description: Snap point the sheet opens to when uncontrolled.

entries.name: onSnapChange
entries.description: Called when a drag, key press, or handle tap picks a new snap point.

entries.name: modal
entries.description:
Dim the page, trap focus, and lock scroll. Turn it off for map- or
player-style sheets that leave the page interactive.

entries.name: dismissible
entries.description: Let a downward drag, a flick, Esc, or an overlay click close the sheet.

entries.name: scaleBackground
entries.description: Scale `[data-sheet-wrapper]` back as the sheet reaches full height.

entries.name: desktop
entries.description: How the sheet renders from the `md` breakpoint up.

entries.name: handleOnly
entries.description: Only start drags from `SnapSheet.Handle`.

entries.name: sound
entries.description: Play a click per snap, a pop at full height, and a swoosh on open and dismiss.

entries.name: haptics
entries.description: Trigger haptics on supported devices.

entries.name: soundOnProgrammatic
entries.description: Play cues for open and snap changes that come from props too.

entries.name: value
entries.description: Controlled value, from 0 (empty) to `max`.

entries.name: defaultValue
entries.description: Initial value when uncontrolled.

entries.name: onValueChange
entries.description: Called on every change, including each step of a sweep.

entries.name: onValueCommit
entries.description: Called once a pick lands: on release, a key press, or a clear.

entries.name: max
entries.description: Number of stars, up to 10.

entries.name: allowHalf
entries.description: Let the left half of a star rate x.5.

entries.name: clearable
entries.description: Tapping the current value again, `Backspace` or `Delete` clears it.

entries.name: readOnly
entries.description: Show the value as a single image without interaction.

entries.name: labels
entries.description: Caption per star, e.g. "Poor" to "Excellent". With `allowHalf`, pass one per half step to label halves too.

entries.name: sound
entries.description: Play a click per star crossed and a pop when a pick lands.

entries.name: haptics
entries.description: Trigger haptics on supported devices.

entries.name: name
entries.description: Submits the value with a native form through a hidden input.

entries.name: aria-label
entries.description: Accessible name for the group.

entries.name: label
entries.description: Visible label and accessible name.

entries.name: destructive
entries.description: Collapse the row before calling `onAction`.

entries.name: confirm
entries.description: Ask "Confirm?" in place before firing.

entries.name: announce
entries.description: Live region message once the action fires. Defaults to `label: row label`.

entries.name: onAction
entries.description: Rejecting springs the row back and plays an error.

entries.name: leading
entries.description: Revealed by swiping toward the end edge, listed from the start edge in.

entries.name: trailing
entries.description: Revealed by swiping toward the start edge, listed from the content out.

entries.name: fullSwipe
entries.description: Fire the outermost action on a long swipe or a fast flick.

entries.name: fullSwipeThreshold
entries.description: Share of the row width that arms a full swipe.

entries.name: actionWidth
entries.description: Width of each action, in px. Shrinks to fit narrow rows.

entries.name: showHandle
entries.description: Show a ⋯ button on hover that reveals the actions.

entries.name: showLabels
entries.description: Show labels under icons. Inherits from `SwipeList`.

entries.name: sound
entries.description: Play a toggle when arming and a swoosh or pop when an action fires.

entries.name: haptics
entries.description: Trigger haptics on supported devices.

entries.name: label
entries.description: Accessible name for the row, used in announcements.

entries.name: variant
entries.description: `inset` rounded cards with a gap, or `plain` edge-to-edge rows.

entries.name: showLabels
entries.description: Show labels under icons for every row.

entries.name: label
entries.description: Accessible name for the list.

entries.name: onThemeChange
entries.description: Called with the resolved theme after it changes.

entries.name: lightIcon
entries.description: Custom icon for the light theme.

entries.name: darkIcon
entries.description: Custom icon for the dark theme.

entries.name: value
entries.description: Controlled value.

entries.name: defaultValue
entries.description: Initial value when uncontrolled; double-click resets to it.

entries.name: onValueChange
entries.description: Called every time the needle crosses onto a new step.

entries.name: onValueCommit
entries.description: Called once the ruler settles after a drag, flick, key, wheel, or preset.

entries.name: majorEvery
entries.description: Steps between medium ticks.

entries.name: labelEvery
entries.description: Steps between labelled ticks.

entries.name: spacing
entries.description: Pixels between ticks. Defaults by `size`.

entries.name: unit
entries.description: Unit shown after the readout, e.g. `min`.

entries.name: format
entries.description: Formats the readout and `aria-valuetext`.

entries.name: presets
entries.description: Values shown as chips that glide the ruler to them.

entries.name: sound
entries.description: Play a click per step and a pop at the bounds.

entries.name: haptics
entries.description: Trigger haptics on supported devices.

entries.name: label
entries.description: Accessible name for the slider.

entries.name: showValue
entries.description: Show the large value readout above the ruler.

entries.name: color
entries.description: Color used by the wave, pointer glow, and sparks.

entries.name: word
entries.description: Text rendered into the tile grid.
